# DMDS — Tampa Bay Digital Studio

> DMDS (DM Digital Solutions) is a one-engineer digital studio in Palm Harbor, FL building websites, apps, AI automation and digital marketing systems for Tampa Bay businesses — engineered with flight-software discipline. Every quantitative claim on the studio page lives in a versioned claims registry and every release is test-attested (the certificate binds the exact served bytes).

Contact: dennis@dmds.studio

## Pages

- [Studio](https://dmds.studio/): identity, capabilities (web design, web development, app development, AI automation, digital marketing), proof-of-work dossiers (Zoo Code AI platform, Insure With Mink growth engine, a private-engagement HVAC field-service platform), claims registry and release-attestation trail
- [Contractor Web Design — Tampa Bay](https://dmds.studio/contractor-web-design-tampa/): web design for contractors and trade businesses (marine, tree, HVAC) across Tampa Bay. Diagnosis-first structure with a free website diagnosis as the entry step, published pricing (builds $3,500–$8,500; BASE $95/month, GROWTH $495/month), an objection FAQ, an honest "who this is not for" section, and client ownership of the site, domain, and content
- [Promotional Products — Tampa Bay](https://dmds.studio/promotional-products/): branded merchandise and commercial print (pens, drinkware, apparel, bags, event goods, cards, signs) for Tampa Bay businesses. DMDS is a promotional products distributor; collateral is designed and sourced by one local contact. Quoted per order as one delivered total with setup and decoration charges included; artwork checked before production; the client owns the production-ready artwork
- [Card Processing for Contractors — Tampa Bay](https://dmds.studio/credit-card-processing-tampa/): credit-card processing for Tampa Bay contractors through a free statement review: the merchant's real effective rate, a line-by-line comparison in writing, interchange-plus pricing, month-to-month terms with no early-termination fee, tap-to-pay and deposit links, and a first-statement check. Dennis Mink is an agent for a payment processor and discloses that he earns on placed accounts
- [Best of Palm Harbor](https://dmds.studio/best-of-palm-harbor/): community page for the raffle basket at the Empowered Life Chiropractic grand opening in Palm Harbor (September 2026). Eighteen local businesses listed alphabetically with owner, contribution where known, and links; designed and donated by DMDS. A showcase, not a ranking

## Facts

- Based in Palm Harbor, FL; serving Tampa Bay (Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater and surrounding communities)
- Pages are single self-contained HTML documents: zero external requests on load, no third-party analytics or trackers
- Founder/operator: Dennis Mink (https://github.com/0xMink)
- Source and release attestation: https://github.com/0xMink/dmds
